thread:
mia (product): Quick sync: we need a short compliance readiness checklist for Redwood Private customers pursuing SOC2/ISO. Major asks from partner: audit-ready evidence bundles, configurable retention, and clear escrow/key-handling.

jon (eng): Tech constraints: Private installs can surface local storage and use customer KMS. We should provide a standard export format and a small CLI helper to pull manifests. Prefer tagging blobs with retention_label.

anya (security): Checklist items (high-level): 1) tamper-evident manifests (sha256 + signer id); 2) per-tenant audit trail with requester identity; 3) retention override for legal holds; 4) BYOK signing option with threat-model note.

ravi (legal): Add: contract clauses for extended retention, cross-border export permissions, and SLAs for evidence production. Also require attestation template for customers to present to auditors.

carl (sales): Customers want a one-page summary of what we deliver vs what they operate in their Private deployment. That will speed procurement.

mia (product): Action: I'll draft a 1-page readiness checklist + an appendix with manifest schema. @jon add CLI helper spec (due Tue), @anya produce BYOK primer (due Wed), @ravi craft contract snippets (due Wed). Put this as candidate for next sprint.

jon (eng): Sample manifest snippet I'll include in spec:

```
manifest_v1:\n- tenant: t-777\n- created: 2025-09-01T12:00:00Z\n- files:\n  - path: evidence/events-20250901.ndjson.gz\n    sha256: <hex>\n- signed_by: redwood-kms:sign-1\n- retention_label: extended\n```

anya (security): Ensure CLI signs export request and records audit event. Also note: if customer KMS is used, we require proof-of-possession flow.

mia (product): Thanks. If no objections I'll circulate the draft by EOD and slot review on Thursday.

carl (sales): No objections. Will attach customer language examples.

mia (product): Closing thread.
